purpose: Public-safe structured project map for the homepage portfolio helper.

site.title: Grant McCurdy Learning Systems Portfolio
site.summary: A problem-led public portfolio for assessment, measurement, learning analytics, education data systems, human-reviewed AI workflows, and technical implementation.

campaignEvidence.policy: Use only the fourteen qualification-bound claims below for reusable 2026 Q3 campaign technical statements. Preserve project-level featured or supporting eligibility and each exact qualification.

projects.title: Statistical Risk Modeling in R
projects.summary: An R pipeline generates public-safe longitudinal assessment data, searches multiple model families, performs temporal and holdout validation, and renders analyst and executive decision-support artifacts.

claims.statement: Built a public-safe R assessment-growth modeling workflow with model-family search, temporal validation, a locked holdout, and stakeholder-facing reporting.
Designed decision guardrails that convert teacher, course, and section residuals into review priorities rather than automated evaluations.

projects.qualification: Strongest campaign evidence for measurement, validation, and decision support. Public use should surface the below-target validity gates; an interview rebuild needs the reproducibility work item first.

projects.title: Assessment Intelligence
projects.summary: The portfolio dashboard presents the same synthetic mathematics data, figures, and findings as the Logos department report. The public Assessment Intelligence repository retains the separate earlier SQL/dbt/DuckDB implementation; the proof claims below describe that earlier implementation.

claims.statement: Designed a governed assessment analytics path from synthetic LMS-style warehouse records through dbt marts, parity gates, stakeholder reports, and a hash-bound dashboard payload.
Implemented data-quality and disclosure guardrails that separate non-participation from achievement and suppress small cohorts from ranked findings.

projects.qualification: Strongest education-data architecture candidate once the dbt check is relocatable. Static artifacts are reviewable now, but a live interview rebuild and public feature must use the repaired, release-synchronized commit.

projects.title: Assessment-to-Remediation Pipeline
projects.summary: The current slice produces a 36-item math-readiness diagnostic, validates its structure, renders student and instructor previews, records GPT-5.5 advisory reviews, and builds an offline Canvas New Quizzes payload. Scoring, simulated attempts, remediation, reassessment, and mastery reporting remain planned.

claims.statement: Implemented an inspectable assessment-authoring workflow that validates 36 original math-readiness items, renders reviewer previews, and produces an offline Canvas New Quizzes payload.
Designed a human-review boundary around AI-assisted item and visual review before LMS export.

projects.qualification: Strong visual and workflow story if explicitly framed as the implemented authoring-review-export slice. Accessibility and clean demo verification should be completed before a high-stakes interview walkthrough.

projects.title: Education Data Simulation Engine
projects.summary: Generates a coherent seven-year synthetic mathematics department, validates cross-table invariants, builds Canvas-style records and a DuckDB star schema, and exports marts consumed by Assessment Intelligence.

claims.statement: Built a deterministic synthetic education-data foundation with nested school structure, Canvas-style records, longitudinal assessment data, and a local analytics warehouse.
Implemented validation that reconciles enrollment, assessment, non-participation, and LMS-style records before downstream reporting.

projects.qualification: Strong supporting architecture evidence and the privacy foundation for Assessment Intelligence; the local commit is demo-ready, but public featuring must wait for separately approved remote release synchronization.

projects.title: Instructional AI Workflows
projects.summary: A synthetic Precalculus free-response demo converts teacher-defined rubrics and observations into structured evaluations, a reviewer packet, student-facing feedback, and remediation plans without grading raw work automatically.

claims.statement: Built a teacher-controlled rubric-to-feedback workflow that makes evaluation evidence, review status, and remediation outputs inspectable.
Demonstrated an offline, deterministic human-in-the-loop design that requires no live LMS or AI service.

projects.qualification: Clear supporting example of governed AI-assisted instructional workflow design; less technically deep than the top three campaign projects.

projects.title: Content Intelligence
projects.summary: The repository normalizes synthetic text, transcript-derived, OCR-derived, and Markdown material into provenance-rich objects, gates retrieval inputs for safety, produces local lexical/vector records, and exposes portable hybrid retrieval logic used by a public cited-answer demo.

claims.statement: Built an artifact-to-RAG pipeline that preserves source identity, checksums, citations, safety state, and corpus fingerprints through retrieval.
Implemented privacy and answer-grounding gates that block unreviewed inputs and require cited, bounded responses.

projects.qualification: Strong general AI systems alternate with unusually clear provenance and governance evidence; less education-specific than the top three.

projects.title: Graduate Statistics Portfolio
projects.summary: Public-safe scripts regenerate a nonlinear signal analysis and a clinical risk GLM analysis, including candidate searches, cross-validation, diagnostics, calibration, threshold tables, figures, and narrative summaries.

claims.statement: Curated and rebuilt graduate statistical work as public-safe R pipelines with model comparison, cross-validation, calibration, diagnostics, and cautious interpretation.
Demonstrated both predictive-model evaluation and nonlinear model-family search using reproducible reviewer artifacts.

projects.qualification: Strong supporting credential evidence for statistical depth and reproducibility; local artifacts are demo-ready, but public featuring must wait for separately approved synchronization of the ahead-of-remote commit.

analyticSurfaces.title: Assessment Analytics
analyticSurfaces.boundary: Logos synthetic report: 500 students, 21 classes, one 30-question administration. Separate from the longitudinal warehouse.

analyticSurfaces.title: Education Data Lab
analyticSurfaces.boundary: Read-only analysis over a public-safe synthetic education warehouse.
